description.zh-CN: 只读文件操作：读文件 / 列目录 / 搜索文本
description.en-US: Read-only file ops: read / list / grep

tools.name: fs.read
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file. Args: path (string, absolute), max_bytes (number, default 32768, max 1048576). Output is truncated at max_bytes; the response flags `truncated`.

tools.name: fs.list
tools.description: List a directory (dirs first, then files, with type and size). Args: path (string, absolute).

tools.name: fs.grep
tools.description: Case-insensitive substring search over text files in a directory tree. Args: path (absolute), query (string), max_results (default 50, max 200), max_depth (default 3, max 8).
